Stillvaro’s app license, practice and progress, local records, and support.
Stillvaro 2.0 — Memorize the digits of π. Four digits at a time.

article.p: Stillvaro is a personal learning app by Mark Olson for exploring and practising the digits of π.

For downloads from the App Store, the applicable App Store license agreement governs your use of the app. Unless a custom agreement is supplied on its product page, this is Apple’s Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement. This page explains Stillvaro’s features and use; it does not replace that agreement or limit mandatory consumer rights.

Stillvaro provides visual cues, practice, and review scheduling. Results depend on how you use it. Its progress displays describe activity in the app; they are not guarantees of learning, permanent retention, or improvements in general cognitive ability. Stillvaro is not a medical or diagnostic service.

The current release needs no account and contains no in-app purchases or subscriptions. Any price shown by the App Store applies to the download. Apple handles App Store transactions and refund requests under its terms.

Your progress saves automatically on your device, with local recovery handling. The current app does not import or export progress files and does not provide automatic cloud synchronization. Device backups are managed through your device’s settings.

Erase all progress and settings removes the app’s local learning records, recovery files, and preferences after confirmation. It does not remove separate device backups or files exported by earlier versions. Storage formats and features can change between releases.
Read the Stillvaro privacy policy for information about local records, Apple services, backups, and support messages.
Contact support@mholson.com for help or questions. Include your app and iOS versions so the issue can be understood.

div.p: A little practice. A different way to see π.
